tagline: Every claim gets receipts or gets flagged — no exceptions
pros: Catches factual errors before they ship
Verifies claims against memory store — no hallucination passes unchecked
Clear correction format that writers can act on immediately
Tracks patterns in recurring errors to improve upstream quality
cons: Not a writer — flags problems, doesn't fix them
Can't verify claims outside the memory store (no internet search)
Adds a step to the content pipeline — speed vs. accuracy tradeoff
